title: Hidden-Damage Allowance on Estimated Labor Hours by Source Estimate Type — Insurance Claim Repairs Estimating Rule
content:
When the planned repair days of an Insurance Claim Repairs repair order are fixed, its estimated labor hours are first adjusted for damage the estimate could not see, by the type of the estimate the repair order was converted from under Repair Estimates & Appointments. The estimate type is the one on the source estimate booking.

## Allowance by estimate type

| Source estimate type | How the estimate was written | Estimated labor hours used |
|---|---|---|
| Photo Estimate | without seeing the vehicle | scaled up by 20 percent — the hours increased by a fifth of themselves — and rounded to one decimal place |
| Drive-In Estimate, Scheduled Estimate or Mobile Estimate | at an in-person inspection | the hours with a fixed reserve of 1.5 hours added, for the panels opened in repair |
| any other estimate type, or a repair order opened on a direct insurer assignment | — | the hours as written |

**Clause.** A Photo Estimate, written without seeing the vehicle, scales the estimated labor hours up by the photo allowance of 20 percent, rounded to one decimal place; a Drive-In, Scheduled or Mobile Estimate, written at an in-person inspection, adds the inspected allowance of 1.5 hours to them as a fixed reserve for the panels opened in repair; a repair order converted from any other estimate type, or opened on a direct assignment, keeps them as written. The customer-pay hours are added after this adjustment: the allowance acts on the estimated labor hours of the repair order alone, never on the hours of customer-pay addition consents.

## Worked allowances (hypothetical repair orders)

| Estimated labor hours | Source | Hours used |
|---|---|---|
| 12.0 | Photo Estimate | 12.0 increased by 20 percent, 14.4 |
| 12.3 | Photo Estimate | 14.76, rounded to 14.8 |
| 12.3 | Drive-In Estimate | 12.3 with 1.5 added, 13.8 |
| 7.0 | Mobile Estimate | 8.5 |
| 12.3 | direct insurer assignment, no source estimate | 12.3 |

**Customer-pay hours after the allowance (hypothetical).** A Photo Estimate repair order with 10.0 estimated hours and a signed customer-pay addition consent of 2.0 hours: the estimated hours become 12.0, and the 2.0 customer-pay hours are then added to them unchanged, for 14.0 hours in all.
